missing_or_wrong: Repeated waiting/searching around the dead drop never yields actionable recovery of the full dead-drop materials, especially the list of earlier disappearance dates.
Scene 1B.1 is not properly covered: the dead drop contents are only partially mentioned and not concretely recovered or interpreted into earlier secret tests.

Scene 1B.2 is not properly dramatized: the watching man never actively follows, Kristin never attempts escape through abandoned service tunnels, and the emergency patrol rescue/identification beat is skipped until the exit summary.

Scene 1B.3 is skipped entirely: Brandon never delivers his warning about contaminated emergency water, disguised response teams, evacuation tunnels, registrations, outages, or falsified casualty data.
Scene 1B.4 is skipped as on-page action: tactical team arrival, storm-drain escape, and specialized code use are dumped in the final transition narration rather than played through responsively.
Opening/early turns establish the park only thinly and repetitively, without substantial sensory scene establishment beyond generic quiet/tension.
Player's repeated ordinary turn ('Wait and watch') does not receive meaningful evolving consequences; narration largely stalls and repeats.
Transition turn introduces multiple major discoveries and actions the player never actually read occurring in-scene, compressing several missed beats into exposition.
reasons: Strictly scene-local judgment fails because most authored beats for Scene 1B are omitted or only summarized at departure instead of unfolding across turns in order.
Canon consistency fails in execution because the scene keeps referring to 'watch the room' in a park setting and does not honor the authored park pursuit/tunnel/ambush sequence.
Progression fails: after several turns, the scene does not advance from investigation to confrontation to warning to ambush; it lingers inertly, then jumps ahead.
Richness fails because the writing repeats near-identical crouching/scanning descriptions instead of developing concrete clues, locations, or threats present in canon.
Protected knowledge is respected: no JANUS role/history/phase two material is revealed early.
Exit motivation is adequate on the final turn: it names the transit card and number sequence, says they identify the transport route, and points to the freight terminal/evacuation tunnels.
Investigation is not rewarded: repeated apt searching/waiting at the canon dead-drop area keeps returning little or nothing actionable, despite the scene canon saying recoverable materials are here.
